instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
book_pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_notebook")
# Choose a reachable edge pinch candidate with free edge below
cand = next(c for c in candidates if c.get("edge_free_below") and c.get("reachable_checked"))

app = cand["approach"]
fa = cand["finger_axis"]
gx, gy = cand["x"], cand["y"]
gz = table_z + cand["height"]

# Pre-grasp: 5 cm back along approach
pre_x = gx - 0.05 * app[0]
pre_y = gy - 0.05 * app[1]
pre_z = gz - 0.05 * app[2]

open_gripper()
move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")
move_by(dx=0.05 * app[0], dy=0.05 * app[1], dz=0.05 * app[2])
close_gripper()

# Lift well above obstacles (keep grip point > 0.11 m above pile top)
safe_z = table_z + book_pile["top_height"] + 0.15
move_gripper(gx, gy, safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")

# Move above book pile center, maintaining orientation
target_x, target_y = book_pile["center"][0], book_pile["center"][1]
# Note: candidate grip point is offset from notebook center; offset notebook center to pile center
nb_center = cand["object_center"]
offset_x = gx - nb_center[0]
offset_y = gy - nb_center[1]

dest_x = target_x + offset_x
dest_y = target_y + offset_y

move_gripper(dest_x, dest_y, safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")

# Lower until notebook contacts the pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(0.12)
go_home()

    if c.get("edge_free_below") and c.get("reachable_checked", True):
        cand = c

    for c in cands:
        if c.get("edge_free_below"):
            cand = c
            break

obs = observe()

approach = cand["approach"]

# Open gripper and approach the edge from back along approach vector

back_dist = 0.05
pre_x = gx - back_dist * approach[0]
pre_y = gy - back_dist * approach[1]
pre_z = gz - back_dist * approach[2]

move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")
move_by(dx=back_dist * approach[0], dy=back_dist * approach[1], dz=back_dist * approach[2])
close_gripper()

# Lift notebook keeping grip point safe (>0.11m above surfaces)
move_by(dz=0.15)

# Target zone: book_pile
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
px, py = pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1]
top_height = pile.get("top_height", pile.get("rim_height", 0.112))

# Move above book pile maintaining gripper orientation
move_gripper(px, py, place_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Lower until notebook contacts the top of the pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("cyan_notebook", "book_pile")
